"Plowed" is a song by American rock band Sponge.
The song was released in 1994 as the second single from the group's debut studio album Rotting Piñata.
"Plowed" is also featured on the band's compilation albums Molly and Hits & B Sides, Volume One, and was re-recorded for Hits & B Sides, Volume Two and for their 2021 album, Lavatorium.
Rotting Piñata is the debut studio album by the American rock band Sponge, released on August 2, 1994, through Work Group.

Hit singles from this album, such as "Plowed" and
"Molly (16 Candles Down the Drain)", helped launch the band's career and the album was certified gold by the RIAA in July 1995.

Background
The title of the album (and song of the same name) came from a conversation the band had regarding controversial punk rock singer GG Allin, who infamously promised for years that he would die by suicide on stage during one of his concerts (Allin instead died from an accidental drug overdose).
